warnings.headline: Possibility of very heavy rain, yellow level, Parts of Troms and northern Nordland, 2026-10-19T02:00:00+00:00, 2026-10-20T08:00:00+00:00
warnings.description: There is possibility of very much rain, locally around 50-80 mm in 24 hours. The warning will be upgraded to orange level if the weather situation indicates it.
warnings.instruction: Flooding will occur: Clear drains and gutters so water can flow away. Difficult driving conditions: Check road conditions at vegvesen.no/trafikk. Adjust your speed and drive according to the conditions. Consider if travel is necessary. Some places may lose road access: Follow advice from local emergency authorities. Flooding and landslides: Check warnings at Varsom.no.
areas: Parts of Troms and northern Nordland

warnings.headline: Strong wind gusts, yellow level, Parts of Troms and northern Nordland, 2026-10-19T01:00:00+00:00, 2026-10-19T21:00:00+00:00
warnings.description: Locally strong wind gusts around 27-33 m/s are expected from southwest, and severe gale force 9 to storm force 10 at the coast. The wind will decrease last in the north.
warnings.instruction: Secure loose objects: Consider taking precautions to prevent damage before the event occurs. Avoid unnecessary travel in exposed areas. Risk of traffic obstructions: Check road reports on vegvesen.no/trafikk.
areas: Parts of Troms and northern Nordland

warnings.headline: Yellow Wind in the alpine region Northern Lapland Mountains
warnings.description:
During the night towards Monday, the southwest and west winds will increase, on the bare mountains very strong winds, on the high mountains storms. On Monday morning, there will also be snowfall that will turn into rain.; What happens?: During Monday, the wind will increase between a low pressure on the Arctic Ocean and a high pressure over southern Sweden. On the bare mountains 18-24 m/s, on the high mountains 23-30 m/s. Monday morning, mainly in the western mountains, also increasing snowfall that will turn into rain quite quickly. Smaller amounts are expected in the southern part of the warning area.
Wind and rain will ease overnight into Tuesday.; What should I think about?: Do not hike
warnings.sender: SMHI, Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute
